correctness.rationale: The exact unnormalized character eigenvalues follow by completing the square in the quadratic Gauss sum; the Salié identity is justified by additive Fourier inversion. Opposite radius classes ensure one nonzero eigenvalue at each nonzero dual norm; the isotropic modes contribute 2q^m. Dual sphere multiplicities and the exact nonzero trace-pair product 2^((q/p-1)/2) yield |det K|=2^(q^d/p) q^(m q^d). A represented square v^2/r and surjective trace give the smallest cosine exactly. Tested exact determinants for p=3 and p=5 and all Fourier frequencies for p=3,5,7 and F9 in the embedded checker. Finite checks are supplemental only.

value.rationale: The determinant of an enormous natural integer adjacency-difference filter simplifies to only the two primes 2 and p, immediately settling invertibility in every other characteristic. The exact inverse condition number depends only on the field characteristic, not dimension, field extension degree, form or chosen radii. This resolves a specific motivated stable reconstruction question for complementary spherical data rather than a numerical example or renaming of the single-radius spectrum.
